description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange with effect from 2017.05.29 to 2017.06.04
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it constitutes a statutory instrument that modifies how customs regulations are applied, specifically the calculation of duties based on currency exchange rates. While it names an official (Acting Director General of Customs), this is in an operational/capacity context to establish the legal authority for the notification, not to announce a personnel change or describe government portfolio responsibilities.
